verdict.rationale: Supermemory offers a documented REST API with official TypeScript/Python SDK clients, self-hosting as a single self-contained binary that boots without Docker or config, and a self-hostable memory engine suitable for scripted/CI use. However, there is no explicit CI/headless-automation example, no CLI/GitHub Actions integration, and no evidence of a documented CI workflow or headless test corroboration. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation or example, dedicated CLI for scripted headless runs, independent/hands-on confirmation of headless operation in pipelines.
